evidence: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/mnt/notes

evidence: ~/Library/Application Support/Quill

evidence: Removing the app does not remove your vaults

evidence: Editor text size in points, from 8 to 32

evidence: How many daily snapshots of the vault to retain

evidence: When a setting appears in both files, the vault file wins
